main_text.head: VALOR Ratiociniorum in hoc SERMONE DEMONSTRATUS.
main_text.p: §. 1.EX ipsâ versus ultimi conclusione facile constat, quem scopum collimet praesens Vatis nostri disceptatio: ut scilicet non intendat omnem à populo castigationem divinam avertere, sed foluminodo[?] mitigationem ejus impetrare. Metus est, à crudelissimo & superbissimo hoste nil exspectandum esse, praeter universum populi judaici excidium, quo cum etiam omni per Mosen praescripto legis cultui interitum minabatur. Negat ul-lam ab istius ingenii hoste miserationem aut clementiam esse sperandam Judæis, nisi Deus huic monarchiæ terminos, & monarchæ modum ponat.
§. 2.Rationes, quarum pondera nobis expendenda sunt, id solidissimè urgent, *quod intendunt justi.

1. Ratio prior, à foedere Dei desumpta, per modum restipulationis repetit promissorum in foedere praestationem: addixerat enim Jehovah patribus se fore illis, nec non femini eorum (id est posteris Judaeis) in Deum, & quidem לְעוֹלָם[?] in aeternum; quâ transfactione in se susceperat hunc populum ut cultorem & clientem suum tueri, ne plane emoriatur; ac proin fal-
Q q 2 - Ratio prior: the text continues on the next page.

page.notes: Printed "foluminodo" (for solummodo) is doubtful; kept as printed with [?]. The Hebrew word לעולם is read from a small, faded scan; vowel points are uncertain. The catchword "vâ" is faint. The "*" before "quod" is a printed mark, kept as is. A stray dot after "ponat." is not text and was left out. The woodcut initial E is read as "EX". The foot line in main_text duplicates the signature and is not printed on the page; it should be removed.
